spans.s: बदर (I) m. The jujube tree.
बदर (II) n. The fruit of the jujube, करबदरसदृशमखिलं भुवनतलं यत्प्रसादतः कवयः पश्यंति Vas.D.
बादर (I) a. (f. री) 1. Belonging to the jujube tree; 2. made of cotton.
बादर (II) m. The cotton shrub.
बादर (III) n. 1. The jujube; 2. silk; 3. water; 4. a garment made of cotton; 5. a conch shell that winds from left to right.
बादरा f. The cotton shrub.
बदर-पाचन n. name of a sacred bathing-place.
बदरिका f. 1. The jujube tree and its fruit, e.g. अन्ये बदरिकाकारा बहिरेव मनोहराः Hit.i.; 2. name of one of the sources of the Ganges and of the neighbouring hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa.
बादरिक a. (f. की) Picking up jujubes.
बदरिका-आश्रम m. the hermitage at Badarikā.
बदरी f. 1. The jujube tree; 2. a name of one of the sources of the Ganges and of the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa.
बादर (I) a. (f. री) 1. Belonging to the jujube tree; 2. made of cotton.
बदरी-तपोवन n. the penance-grove at Badarī, बदरीतपोवनमिवास निरतम् Kir.xii.33.
बदरी-फल n. the fruit of the jujube tree.
बदरी-वण, -वन n. wood of jujube trees.
बदरी-वण, -वन n. wood of jujube trees.
बदरी-शैल m. a rocky eminence near Badarī.

बद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Bound, tied, fettered; 2. captured; 3. confined, imprisoned; 4. suppressed, withheld; 5. combined, united; 6. manifested, displayed; 7. cherished, entertained, (pp. of बंध् q.v.).

बद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Bound, tied, fettered; 2. captured; 3. confined, imprisoned; 4. suppressed, withheld; 5. combined, united; 6. manifested, displayed; 7. cherished, entertained, (pp. of बंध् q.v.).
बद्ध-अंगुलित्र, -अंगुलित्राण a. having a finger-guard fastened on.
बद्ध-अंगुलित्र, -अंगुलित्राण a. having a finger-guard fastened on.
बद्ध-अंजलि a. with hands joined in humble entreaty, putting the joined hands to the forehead as a mark of respect.
बद्ध-अनुराग a. manifesting love, feeling affection.
बद्ध-आयुध a. accoutred with arms.
बद्ध-आशंक a. one whose suspicions are raised.
बद्ध-उत्सव a. enjoying a holiday, observing a festival.
बद्ध-उद्यम a. making efforts.
बद्ध-कक्ष, -कक्ष्य a. having the girdle girt up, i.e. prepared, ready.
बद्ध-कक्ष, -कक्ष्य a. having the girdle girt up, i.e. prepared, ready.
बद्ध-कोप a. 1. entertaining a feeling of anger; 2. smothering resentment.
बद्ध-चित्त, -मनस् a. riveting the mind.
बद्ध-चित्त, -मनस् a. riveting the mind.
बद्ध-जिह्व a. tongue-tied.
बद्ध-दृष्टि a. having the eyes fixed.
बद्ध-धार a. flowing continuously.
बद्ध-नेपथ्य a. attired in a theatrical costume.
बद्ध-परिकर a. See बद्धकक्ष.
बद्ध-प्रतिज्ञ a. one who has made a vow or promise.
बद्ध-भाव a. enamoured of, (with a loc.).
बद्ध-मुष्टि a. having a closed fist.
बद्ध-मूल a. striking root firmly, deeply rooted, बद्धमूलस्य मूलं हि महद्वैरतरोः स्त्रियः Sis.ii.38.
बद्ध-मौन a. keeping silence, त्वच्चरणारविंदविश्लेषदुःखादिव बद्धमौनम् R.xiii.23.
बद्ध-राग a. impassioned.
बद्ध-वसति a. fixing an abode.
बद्ध-वाच् a. maintaining silence.
बद्ध-वैर a. one who has contracted enmity.
बद्ध-शिख a. 1. one whose hair is tied up; 2. one who is still in childhood.
बद्ध-स्नेह a. forming an attachment, conceiving affection for.
बादरायण m. An epithet of Vyāsa as the author of the Vedānta Sūtra; (the identity is doubtful).
बादरायण-सूत्र n. the Vedānta aphorisms.
बादरायण-संबंध m. an imaginary relation supposed to have its origin in the following verse- अस्माकं बदरीचक्रं युष्माकं बदरीतरुः । बादरायणसंबंधो यूयं यूयं वयं वयम् (Modern).
बादरायणि m. An epithet of Suka, son of Vyāsa.
बादरिक a. (f. की) Picking up jujubes.
